title: Building llm-driven “ai” still requires domain knowledge
author: lobsters_ai
summary_raw: <p>I’m in the process of building an llm driven tool to take user questions and answer them using our customer api at $work.</p> <p>A big part of the work is capturing the domain knowledge and writing it down. It’s easier than previous generations of “ai” because the knowledge doesn’t strictly have to be rendered into a structured format, but this is what previous generations of “ai” foundered on.</p>
